priorityList: Cast Flurry to start the cooldown
Activate Time Warp if popping on pull
Cast Flurry if Thermal Void is not already active and you have Brain Freeze
Cast Ice Lance at 10 or more stacks of Freezing, or if Fingers of Frost is active
Cast Flurry if you have a charge available but no Brain Freeze
Consume stacks with Ice Lance and Comet Storm to avoid wasting them
Use Frozen Orb often as it deals high damage
Use Flurry and Glacial Spike often
Cast Frostfire Bolt as the main filler spell
